| **[TRAC: Efficient Diffusion Language Models for Machine Translation via Length-Aware Decoding](http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.25643v1)** [📄](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.25643v1) <details><summary>💬</summary><p>Accepted at CCMT 2026</p></details> | 2026-11-19 | <details><summary>📄 英文原摘要</summary><p>Machine translation with large language models requires both high translation quality and low generation latency. Accelerating translation while preserving quality is therefore essential for practical deployment.
